content: Yambaneke i thotho
Giya Loi i dage weya Nowa iŋa, “U tha e waŋga, ghen, len wevo na len ŋgaŋga na lenji ovo, kaiwae kaero ya thuwe ghen vara ghanɨmbereghana u thovuye moli thake iyake e tɨnenji.

U mbanɨŋgiya thetheghan wevo na ghɨmoru thenjighepirɨ iya, iya va ya dage weŋga ne ya wovatha vowo kaiwae. U mbanɨŋgiya thetheghan yamoyamo wevo na ghɨmoru, iya maa valɨkaiwae vowo, kaiwae thɨ mbighɨ.
Na tembe ŋgoreiyeva maaŋgi, wevo na ghɨmoru thenjighepirɨ iya. U vakatha ŋgoreiyake mbala thetheghan na maa yamoyamo regha na regha mbe e yawayawalinji na tembe thɨ rothirakava e yambaneke.

Mbaŋa mbaŋapirɨ e tɨne ne ya variye uye na i nja e yambaneke. Ne i uyevoreŋa mbaŋa mbaŋaevarɨ na gougouyevarɨ e tɨnenji. Iyake kaiwae lo renuwaŋa ŋgoreiye bigibigike wolaghɨye va ya vakathaŋgi ne ya mukuwoŋgi.”
Nowa i vakatha ŋgoreiya Giya Loi i utugiyakowe.
Nowa ghatheghathegha vama i wo hweseriyewona (600) ambama iya yambaneke i thotho eŋge.
Nowa na levo na le ŋgaŋga na lenji ovo thɨ tha e waŋgako na mbala maa thothoko i gaboŋgi.
Thetheghanɨke wolaghɨye, thɨ mbighɨ na maa thɨ mbighɨ na tomethi yamoyamo, wevo na ghɨmoru,
thɨ rakatha e waŋgama weinji Nowa ŋgoreiya Loi va i dagemawe.
Mbaŋa theghepirɨ e ghereiye thothoma kaero i voro.

Mbaŋa Nowa ghatheghathegha hweseriyewona, manjala umboiwoniye ghambaŋa theyaworo na theghepirɨninji e tɨne, mbwake wolaghɨye rɨghenji e yambaneke raberabe thiya mavuvao na mbwa e buruburuko tembe ŋgoreiyeva,
ko amba uye i nja e yambaneke mbaŋa mbaŋaevarɨ na gougouyevarɨ.
E mbaŋako iyako vara e tɨne Nowa na levo weinjiyaŋgiya lenji ŋgaŋga, Sem, Ham na Jepet na lenji ovo thɨ tha e waŋgama.
Weinjiyaŋgi thɨ rakatha e waŋgama thetheghanɨke wolaghɨye, tomethi mbe ghanjiyamoyamo, mbwanjam na mbwaeva, thetheghan thɨ loŋga e gharenji vwata na maaŋgi mbe ŋgoreiyeva na bigibigi e vinevineinji.
Thetheghanɨko wolaghɨye e yawayawalinji thɨ rakamena weya Nowa, theghewo iya, wevo na ghɨmoru na thɨ rakatha e waŋgama.
Thetheghanɨke wolaghɨye e yawayawalinji, ghɨmoru na wevo Nowa va i vamboromboroŋa ŋgoreiya Loi le renuwaŋa, Nowa i rereghamba vara. Mbaŋa i ru e waŋgama amba Giya i kighɨ eŋge waŋgako ghambwaŋaŋgila.
Thothoma kaero i thothovoreŋa mbaŋa mbaŋaevarɨ na kaero i dumwaga na i vakatha waŋgako i ghagha.
Mbwako ma i vorovorowo eŋge na kaero i ghagha loloŋga e vwatae.
Mbwako kaero ina yavoro moli na kaero i wovululuŋgiya ououko wolaghɨye e yambaneke.
Vambema le didivoro eŋge tembema i wo eŋge mita theghepirɨ le ghenevoro e ououko molamolao vwatanji.
Bigibigike wolaghɨye e yawayawalinji na inanji e yambaneke thiya marevaoma, thetheghan na gharɨgharɨ.
Bigibigike wolaghɨye iya thɨ liliya yawalinji e yambaneke thiya marevao.

Bigibigike wolaghɨye e yawayawalinji Giya Loi va i mukuwoŋgi — gharɨgharɨ, thetheghan thɨ loŋgaloŋga e yambaneke vwatae na ma thɨ yoyo, thiya marevao. Vama Nowa eŋge na thavala weiyaŋgi e waŋgako tɨne vambe nanjiwe.
Thothoko va i voro na ghaghadɨko va i wo vara mbaŋa mbaŋathaŋarɨ na mbaŋaelima (150).
